messages:
maria: quick alert — after the node bounce in dedicated-vpc-3 we observed requests authenticated with ephemeral-admin tokens for ~7m post-bounce. no matching KMS Decrypt events in audit logs for those requests :thinking:
kevin: how are you validating 'ephemeral-admin' acceptance? curl logs or app traces?
rachel: paste of app log snippet:
```
2026-03-19T22:14:03Z INFO auth: token=ephemeral-admin-xyz method=CreateModel allowed=true principal=svcacct-onprem duration=00:00:00.123
2026-03-19T22:15:12Z INFO request: route=/v1/models generate status=200 token=ephemeral-admin-xyz
```
kevin: those look legit. do we see the token issuance event around 22:07-22:10? run `SELECT * FROM issued_tokens WHERE token LIKE 'ephemeral-admin-%' ORDER BY issued_at DESC LIMIT 5;`
sam: also check cache TTL on the private control plane side, we recently bumped prefix caching for KV to 10m during a perf test — might be serving stale allowlist state after node restart. :eyes:
maria: i ran the DB query — issuance time is 22:06:18, TTL configured as 5m though. weird. DB shows revoke after 22:09 but requests continued until ~22:15.
audit-bot: audit:event type=auth_check token=ephemeral-admin-xyz outcome=allowed resource=/v1/models principal=svcacct-onprem note="no kms:Decrypt recorded"
kevin: can you dump control-plane cache keys? `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer admin-token" https://private-controlplane/dump-cache | jq '.keys | map(select(.|test("ephemeral-admin")))'`
rachel: output shows the token key present in cache with expiry_ts 2026-03-19T22:16:40Z, even though DB revoke at 22:09.
kevin: that explains it — cache invalidate on revoke didn't make it through during the bounce. what bounced exactly? kube node restart or control-plane failover?
maria: kube node restart for the inference pods + control-plane HA failover at ~22:05 during rolling upgrade. we should have an invalidate hook on KMS-backed revokes.
sam: note: KMS integration call path for revokes is async. revoke -> write tombstone -> enqueue cache-invalidate job (pubsub) -> workers process. Suspect pubsub worker didn't pick up message while we were losing connectivity.
security: can we confirm whether these requests touched customer data or just metadata? severity depends on that.
rachel: looked through request payloads — mostly model inf requests for internal test keys, no PII. still concerning for roles/privilege correctness.
kevin: short-term mitigation: force cache flush across control-plane instances: `for i in $(kubectl get pods -l app=controlplane -o name); do kubectl exec $i -- /bin/controlplane-cli cache flush --pattern 'ephemeral-admin-*'; done`
maria: running the flush now. will monitor for rejections.
sre-bot: deploy:rollback job triggered on controlplane/rollout at 22:18 by @kevin — reason: cache-invalidate hotfix.
maria: after flush we see auth checks failing for the token as expected at 22:19. good. need root cause: why revoke enqueue failed under node bounce.
kevin: hypothesis: pubsub client didn't ack to broker before connection tear, message never delivered. capture broker logs for 22:05-22:12.
audit-bot: audit:events scanned 22:00-22:30 — 238 auth_check events, 14 auth_checks with revoked tokens accepted, 0 kms:Decrypt events for those 14.
security: file an incident ticket (INC-2026-03-19-ephemeral-cache) and schedule a postmortem. also verify KMS key policy for service account used by revoke-worker has decrypt/audit perms.
maria: opened INC-2026-03-19-ephemeral-cache, adding logs and db dumps. assigning to kevin+sam+rachel.
sam: longer-term: make revoke path synchronous for ephemeral-admin role (ack on write) or ensure at-least-once delivery for invalidate messages + retry/backoff. also add a control-plane startup self-check: compare DB revocation watermark with cache state and resync on mismatch.
kevin: agreed. will prototype a simple resync that runs on control-plane bootstrap.
rachel: I'll add monitoring: metric `auth.cache_mismatch_count` and alert if >0 for 1m.
maria: thanks all. small action list: 1) force flush (done), 2) gather broker logs (kevin), 3) check revoke-worker perms on KMS (security), 4) implement bootstrap resync + metric (sam+rachel).
security: please cc compliance for the paper trail. tagging @compliance. :thumbsup:
kevin: will follow up with PRs and an incident summary in the ticket.
maria: closing slack thread, continuing the investigation in INC-2026-03-19-ephemeral-cache. thanks everyone.
